pr.title: chore(ui): v2.10 UI repairs review candidate (do not merge)

preflight.required_checks: CI Green and Guard Release Trigger completed successfully for the exact candidate SHA.
preflight.execution_context: Primary agent context; scoped local Git commits succeeded, unlike the delegated executor's read-only .git sandbox.

preview.allowed_follow_up: Bounded read-only loopback URL/marker/CSS checks and one candidate-scoped teardown if verification fails and a record exists.

allowed_operations_if_approved.execution_context: Primary agent /root only; do not delegate launcher invocation to a read-only Git sandbox.
allowed_operations_if_approved.read_only_url_marker_checks: After a passing launch, verify the documented Plan 178-23 loopback review URLs, page markers, and current CSS identity; do not relaunch.
allowed_operations_if_approved.failure_cleanup_once: If launch or post-launch verification fails and a candidate record exists, run exactly once: bash scripts/check_phase178_candidate.sh --teardown reference/demo_app/tmp/phase178_candidate/recovery-cycle-06/candidate-8e501960.json. If failure occurs before record creation, the launcher exit trap removes the temporary run parent.
allowed_operations_if_approved.success_disposition: Keep a fully passing candidate preview running for owner review and report its actual base URL and teardown command.

resource_scope.network_binding: Loopback 127.0.0.1 only, using newly allocated ports
resource_scope.candidate_resources: Only the candidate demo and demo_db Compose project, its network and volumes, candidate worktree, temporary run directory, route output, and cookie jar.
resource_scope.owner_demo: Do not alter mailglass-storybook-review-demo or unrelated containers, networks, and volumes.
resource_scope.docker_image_and_global_cache: No global image/cache prune. Teardown removes this candidate's project resources but does not prune its project-tagged image or global build cache.
resource_scope.hosted_side_effects: Zero hosted workflow runs and no PR writes; --require-ci performs read-only check-run lookup.

cost.local_docker_cost: Local CPU, disk, network downloads on cache miss, Docker image/build cache and isolated containers; no dollar estimate.

stop_rules: Immediately before launch, recheck candidate, launcher hash, remote refs, PR identity, required checks, release ledger, cost disposition, and prior cycle hash. Stop on any drift.
Run only from the primary agent context. If Git worktree creation still fails, preserve the surfaced Git diagnostic, stop, and do not retry.
If any route, marker, CSS, or CI check fails, preserve evidence, teardown only this candidate project once if its record exists, and do not retry.
Do not push, edit PR, dispatch CI, merge, release, publish, deploy, globally prune Docker state, or modify the owner demo.
next_action: Run the one approved local preview command from the primary context, then verify bounded read-only URLs/markers.
